serial_timing_audit.limitation: No per-process start/end timestamps or device occupancy history. Block windows plus bound serial coordinator code support no overlap among these scheduled runs, but do not establish absence of unrelated GPU load.

test_source_initial_arrays.scope: Read only completed terminal receipts and original DRM path / initial-region arrays. No full aggregation, model/solver/GPU call, or full trajectory validation. Unfinished single sides are not differences.
test_source_initial_arrays.interpretation: All 331 task groups with at least two sealed original DRM paths are byte-identical across their saved paths; 89 groups have fewer than two and establish no cross-method path equality. Of 283 EI_ZO-path/LGCS-path pairs with both initial arrays saved, 281 are identical and 2 differ. Do not call the original full-flow experiment a shared-initial-region comparison.
